com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Change selected settings on a saved automation rule or pause it. Changes affect future matching invoices; approval can trigger configured accounting export. Enable or edit export and notification actions in IPP. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview pausing the automation rule we selected. Show its current actions, including any approval/export effects, and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_update_automation_rule, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare a sparse change to an exact rule. Existing blank conditions cannot be re-enabled; export/notification rules may be paused here but enabling/editing them uses IPP. Requires approval-scope confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: update_automation_rule
title: Change an automation rule
